action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The spy takes the {@action Dash|SRD52}, {@action Disengage|SRD52}, or {@action Hide|SRD52} action.
Spies use charm and deception to veil their true intentions. If forced into combat, they seek to end such conflicts quietly and decisively.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The spy deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
